Spot.why: the port is code: Lean core, C-Flock's verifier library, the core protocol interface, the LMS verifier (the challenger's signed record) and Lean's hash map (R3's port index, `Registration.portIndex`), no Mathlib and nothing of Security (the layout rule: Lean code never requires Security)
